description.zh: DHCP选项集的ID。最多支持输入20个DHCP选项集的ID。
description.en: The ID of the DHCP options set. You can specify at most 20 IDs.

description.zh:
DHCP选项集的名称。

名称长度为1~128个字符，以英文大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。
description.en:
The name of the DHCP options set.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter.

Valid values:

 
*   tf-testAccVpcDhcpOptionsSets-1585169790614573448
 
    <!-- -->
 
    :
 
    <!-- -->
 
    tf-testAccVpcDhcpOptionsSets-1585169790614573448
 
    <!-- -->
 
    .

description.zh:
主机名后缀，例如example.com。

DHCP选项集关联VPC后，会自动将主机名后缀同步给VPC中ECS实例。
description.en:
The root domain. For example, you can set the value to example.com.

After a DHCP options set is associated with a virtual private cloud (VPC), the root domain in the DHCP options set is automatically synchronized with the ECS instances in the VPC.

description.zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：**1**~**100**，默认值为**10**。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: **1** to **100**. Default value: **10**.

description.zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
- 第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
- 如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的**NextToken**值。
description.en:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:

*   You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request.

*   You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of the **NextToken** parameter.

description.zh:
要查询DHCP选项集所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the DHCP options sets that you want to query.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.
The ID of the resource group to which the DHCP options set belongs.

description.zh:
资源的标签键。最多支持输入20个标签键。如需传入该值，则不能输入空字符串。

一个标签键最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en:
The tag key. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length and can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). The tag key must start with a letter but cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. The tag key cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh:
资源的标签值。最多支持输入20个标签值。如需传入该值，可以输入空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en:
The tag value. You can specify at most 20 tag values. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). The tag value must start with a letter but cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. The tag value cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

title.zh: 查询已创建的DHCP选项集列表

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc list-dhcp-options-sets --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --next-token FFmyTO70tTpLG6I3FmYAXGKPd0000 --max-results 10 --domain-name example.com --dhcp-options-set-name test --dhcp-options-set-id dopt-o6w0df4epg9zo8isy0000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmxazb4ph0000 --tags Value=FinanceJoshua Key=FinanceDept --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun vpc ListDhcpOptionsSets --region cn-hangzhou --Tags.1.Value FinanceJoshua --NextToken FFmyTO70tTpLG6I3FmYAXGKPd0000 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmxazb4ph0000' --DomainName 'example.com' --DhcpOptionsSetId.1 'dopt-o6w0df4epg9zo8isy0000' --MaxResults 10 --DhcpOptionsSetName test --Tags.1.Key FinanceDept --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
